answer: PoA derives trust from normalized EigenTrust-style ratings, applying exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates corroborated trust, not a one-way cluster’s claims. A fresh Sybil identity has little trusted incoming support and near-zero eigenvector centrality, so it cannot meet consensus thresholds without genuine history. A vine cannot take root on bare basalt just by appearing on a knoll.
